tips.text: Pick Gara in Circuit week 10 if it lines up; it hands you every blueprint with no quest or bounty luck.
Mine ore and fish during the part bounties; the Plains materials come from the same map.
Take the bounty from Konzu or a Plains tent before loading in, or you land in a random public activity.
Use Leave Squad if your squad quits and you want to finish the bounty.
Come back for the Level 20-40 bounty once you have a real frame and weapons.
Spread the Suumbaat blueprint purchases over days at low Mastery Rank; the daily standing cap slows them.
Expect the parts to be quick and the mined and refined materials to be the real grind.
